reasons.why: Code is 67% of chars and the largest content class. History is 93% of items but only 20% of chars, and prose is 8% of chars. No built-in strategy beats the default on the tune split: conversation 0.1011, media-metadata 0.1025 and records 0.0966, against default 0.1011 with se about 0.032. Every gap is far under two standard errors, so I keep the default code strategy. No custom strategy is justified, because the profile shows no data type that the built-ins miss and no measured gain.

I leave the query keys unchanged. Name-light weights score 0.0976 and body-heavy 4.0 scores 0.0727, both below the default 0.1011. The best candidate, media-metadata at 0.1025, is only 0.0014 above the default, well under two standard errors. Semantic_weight 0.8 gives an identical 0.1011, and this graph has no vectors. Build keys and semantic_mode stay at the defaults. The tune set is small (n 40) and cannot show a gain for any change. The entities step would cost money and send text to a model, and no figure shows the need. The project has email and phone labels, so I choose no model.
